1: // Canvas Dodge game with enhanced graphics
2: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
3: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
4: // Audio setup
5: const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
6: function playTone(freq, dur) {
7:   const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
8:   const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
9:   osc.frequency.value = freq;
10:   osc.type = 'square';
11:   osc.connect(gain);
12:   gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
13:   gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
14:   osc.start();
15:   osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
16: }
17: // resume audio on first interaction
18: window.addEventListener('click', () => { if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume(); });
19: canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
20: canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
21: 
22: const player = { w: 40, h: 20, x: canvas.width/2 - 20, y: canvas.height - 30, speed: 5 };
23: let asteroids = [];
24: let lives = 3;
25: let score = 0;
26: let frame = 0;
27: let gameOver = false;
28: 
29: 
30: 
31: function update() {
32:   // move stars down to simulate scrolling
33:   stars.forEach(s => {
34:     s.y += 0.5;
35:     if (s.y > canvas.height) { s.y = 0; s.x = Math.random() * canvas.width; }
36:   });
37:   if (gameOver) return;
38:   // player movement
39:   if (keys['ArrowLeft']) player.x = Math.max(0, player.x - player.speed);
40:   if (keys['ArrowRight']) player.x = Math.min(canvas.width - player.w, player.x + player.speed);
41: 
42:   // asteroids
43:   asteroids.forEach(a => a.y += a.speed);
44:   // remove passed asteroids & increase score
45:   asteroids = asteroids.filter(a => {
46:     if (a.y > canvas.height) { score++; playTone(440, 0.05); return false; }
47:     // collision
48:     if (a.x < player.x + player.w && a.x + a.size > player.x && a.y < player.y + player.h && a.y + a.size > player.y) {
49:       playTone(200, 0.2); // collision sound
50:   lives--; if (lives <= 0) { playTone(100, 0.5); gameOver = true; }
51:       return false; // remove collided asteroid
52:     }
53:     return true;
54:   });
55: 
56:   // spawn new asteroids over time
57:   if (frame % 60 === 0) spawnAsteroid();
58:   frame++;
59: }
60: 
61: // Generate starfield background
62: const stars = [];
63: 
64: // Spawn asteroids with rotation
65: function spawnAsteroid() {
66:   const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20;
67:   asteroids.push({
68:     x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - size),
69:     y: -size,
70:     size,
71:     speed: 2 + frame * 0.001,
72:     angle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
73:     rotSpeed: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02
74:   });
75: }
76: 
77: function initStars(count = 100) {
78: function initStars(count = 100) {
79:   for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
80:     stars.push({
81:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
82:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
83:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
84:       alpha: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5
85:     });
86:   }
87: }
88: initStars();
89: 
90: function draw() {
91:   ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
92:   // fill background
93:   ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
94:   ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
95:   // draw starfield
96:   ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
97:   stars.forEach(s => {
98:     ctx.globalAlpha = s.alpha;
99:     ctx.beginPath();
100:     ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
101:     ctx.fill();
102:   });
103:   ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
104:   // player ship (gradient triangle)
105:   const shipGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(player.x, player.y, player.x, player.y + player.h);
106:   shipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#00ffff');
107:   shipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0066ff');
108:   ctx.fillStyle = shipGrad;
109:   ctx.beginPath();
110:   ctx.moveTo(player.x, player.y + player.h);
111:   ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w/2, player.y);
112:   ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w, player.y + player.h);
113:   ctx.closePath();
114:   ctx.fill();
115:   // asteroids
116:   ctx.fillStyle = 'gray';
117:   // draw asteroids as circles with gradient
118:   asteroids.forEach(a => {
119:     // update rotation angle
120:     a.angle += a.rotSpeed;
121:     // draw rotating asteroid as gradient triangle
122:     const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
123:       a.x + a.size/2,
124:       a.y + a.size/2,
125:       a.size*0.2,
126:       a.x + a.size/2,
127:       a.y + a.size/2,
128:       a.size/2
129:     );
130:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#a9a9a9');
131:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
132:     ctx.save();
133:     ctx.translate(a.x + a.size/2, a.y + a.size/2);
134:     ctx.rotate(a.angle);
135:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
136:     ctx.beginPath();
137:     ctx.moveTo(0, -a.size/2);
138:     ctx.lineTo(a.size/2, a.size/2);
139:     ctx.lineTo(-a.size/2, a.size/2);
140:     ctx.closePath();
141:     ctx.fill();
142:     ctx.restore();
143:   });
144:   // HUD
145:   ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
146:   ctx.font = '16px monospace';
147:   ctx.fillText(`Lives: ${lives}`, 10, 20);
148:   ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 40);
149:   if (gameOver) {
150:     ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
151:     ctx.font = '48px monospace';
152:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width/2 - 120, canvas.height/2);
153:   }
154: }
155: 
156: function loop() {
157:   update();
158:   draw();
159:   if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
160: }

164: window.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.key] = false);

166: loop();
